row.notes: djb2-hashes the whole string and looks it up in the cache map at self+0xb970; on a miss copies up to 99 chars, splits with Ne_Crt_StrtokS (delimiters at 0x145614af8), looks each token hash up in the map at self+0xb938 and appends the 16-byte {+8,+0x10} payload of each hit to a new vector (allocator self+0x8210), then inserts hash->vector in the cache. Returns the vector, or 0 (and frees it) when no token matched. Better context needed: what the per-token entries are (likely style or state names).
